entities.summary: The National and University Library "St. Kliment Ohridski" in Skopje is the national library of North Macedonia. It was one of the first institutions established by the decision of the Anti-Fascist Assembly of the National Liberation of Macedonia (ASNOM) on 23 November 1944.
